name: LLMCheck: Apple M5 Ultra (96GB), MLX, Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset, dated 2026-08). M5 Ultra 96GB, MLX, Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M, per-request decode.
notes: Roughly 2x the M5 Max 70B figure (24 vs 12 tok/s) — tracks the 1.2 TB/s vs 614 GB/s bandwidth ratio almost exactly, textbook bandwidth-bound decode.
